desc: Derive maximal-block characterization (at most 3: (W,H), (L−1,H) when H=U, (W,D−1) when W=R) — note: summing only over maximal blocks is WRONG; answer sums over ALL endpoints, so use region-decomposition approach instead

Derive region-decomposition: 10 patterns; within-region counts via S(w,h)=C(w+h+4,h+2)−(w+h+4)−(w+1)(h+1); crossing patterns as O(len) sums; B→L→T and B→R→T via closed-form G functions derived by Vandermonde

Validate formulas against brute force on small random grids (3000 random cases W,H≤6 plus explicit degenerate cases: L=0, R=W, D=0, U=H, single-row/col leftovers — all passed; samples 1–3 values confirmed)

Final audit: C(n,k) guards verified safe for all uses (G_R negative/small args correctly yield 0, matching Vandermonde vanishing terms); MAXN = W+H+5 covers max binomial argument W+H+4; clean final submission code produced (stdin-only, no self-test dead code)
